features.name: Move To and Move From Properties
features.description: Ability to move fields and tables between applications using move to and move from properties on tables and fields.

features.name: Resources in Apps
features.description: Resources in apps has been opened up for everyone to use with support for files in a resource root folder specified in app.json.

features.name: List Resources Function
features.description: Function that allows you to list resources with simple pattern matching to find resources in folders.

features.name: Get Resource as Text and Get Resource as Json
features.description: Functions to retrieve resource content as text or JSON objects, with encoding support and default value handling.
caveats: Encoding specification needed for proper output

features.name: Override Card Page ID
features.description: Ability to override the card page ID on pages, useful when there is no card page ID or when it needs updating.

features.name: User Control Host Page Type
features.description: New page type that allows you to create a page with a full user control inside and nothing else, useful for PowerBI reports or browsers.
caveats: Cannot have actions on the user control

features.name: Report Tooltips
features.description: Tooltips added to reports that provide insight into what the report is about and can be inherited by page actions.

features.name: Excel Layout Multiple Data Sheets
features.description: Property that allows splitting data items into multiple sheets in Excel reports instead of combining all data in one sheet.
caveats: Property can be overridden in report layouts

features.name: Obsolete Report Layouts
features.description: Ability to obsolete report layouts, allowing you to deprecate layouts that do not use new properties.

features.name: Report Pre-rendering and Post Report Triggers
features.description: New triggers on pre-rendering and on post report that provide additional control over report generation.

features.name: Access Target Format in Reports
features.description: Ability to access the target format in reports to change code based on what format is being generated.

features.name: View from Stream
features.description: Ability to preview a report without downloading it first by viewing from stream in the client.
caveats: Supported layouts: list, tall tiles, tiles, analysis

features.name: Negative Numbers in Increment String
features.description: Support for using negative numbers in the increment string function.

features.name: Call Stack Function
features.description: Function that allows you to get the current call stack without throwing an exception for troubleshooting purposes.

features.name: Continue Keyword
features.description: Keyword to skip the current iteration of a loop and move to the next one, improving code readability.

features.name: Multi-line Strings
features.description: Ability to create multi-line strings by prefixing with @ symbol to include new lines in the string literal.

features.name: To Text on Simple Types
features.description: Ability to call to text method on simple types without parameters or with invariant parameter for formatting.

features.name: JSON Object Get Text Method
features.description: Ability to get text directly from JSON objects with simplified access compared to using JsonToken and JsonValue.
caveats: Does not check if property exists
Can throw exception if property missing

features.name: JSON Object Type-specific Get Methods
features.description: Methods to get array, integer, boolean, byte, char and other types directly from JSON objects.

features.name: Read and Write YAML
features.description: Ability to read and write YAML format in JSON objects for configuration files and user editable scenarios.
caveats: BC 25 versions now support read and write from yaml

features.name: About Title and About Text Inheritance
features.description: Ability to inherit about title and about text properties from reports to role explorer without specifying on actions.

features.name: HTTP Client Handler for Testing
features.description: Handler to intercept outbound HTTP requests in tests to avoid calling external services.

features.name: Server Certificate Validation Override
features.description: Ability to disable server certificate validation for testing purposes with local services and self-signed certificates.
